<?php
$conn = mysqli_connect("127.0.0.1","root","","bd_2025_2026");

$login = $_POST['login'];
$password = $_POST['password'];

$res = mysqli_query($conn,"SELECT * FROM users WHERE login='$login'");

if(mysqli_num_rows($res)==0){
    echo "Utilisateur inexistant";
} else {
    $user = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res);
    echo ($user['password']==$password) ? "Bonjour ".$user['nom']." ".$user['Prenom'] : "Mot de passe incorrect";
}

mysqli_close($conn);
?>
